title: Empennage Harnesses — Stabiliser Access Area and Fin Attachment Feeds
abstract: Wiring sheet for the empennage harnesses running through the stabiliser access areas to the fin attachment sensing, with the routes that cross the attachment fitting region.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the empennage harnesses running from the aft fuselage penetration through the stabiliser access areas to the fin attachment position sensing, with the connector list and the support positions.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet is drawn looking aft with the stabiliser at neutral. The run through the stabiliser access area crosses the attachment fitting region, and the support bracket positions there are shown against the fitting datum rather than against the frame, because the fitting is the feature that does not move between build standards. Any change to the fitting arrangement therefore changes this sheet even though no wire is affected.
sections.routing_note: The harnesses leave the aft fuselage penetration and run outboard through zone 331 into zone 341, supported at 250 millimetre intervals, with a service loop at the stabiliser hinge. The run must clear the fitting bearing face by 25 millimetres minimum with the stabiliser at both travel limits.
